findings.finding: Service worker currently caches all successful GET requests; /api/session is GET, so authenticated/API responses may be cached despite static-shell-only claim.
findings.required_fix: Use explicit static-shell allowlist and bypass /api/*, authenticated and operational responses.

findings.finding: Real PWA sync uses IndexedDB getAll on random UUID-keyed commands without deterministic business ordering; offline start/edit/photo/stop chains can replay out of order and share stale expected revisions.
findings.required_fix: Persist explicit sequence/causation order and deterministic revision propagation/conflict handling; add complete offline-chain tests.
